liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Far From Me** (2 reviews): Garcia's solo on Far From Me is singled out as dead-on perfect; Reviewer calls this the best version of Far From Me [34][37]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Bobby ad-libs lyrics and swears during Looks Like Rain, which the reviewer loves; Looks Like Rain is described as dead on [35][37]
- **The Wheel** (1 review, 1 other source): Garcia's extended intro to The Wheel is missing from this soundboard copy; This version includes the Wheel space within the track [14][28]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree has a thick groove, Jerry's vocal sounds angelic, and his solos shred [31]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Tennessee Jed is near album perfection, preferred by the reviewer over the 11-25-1979 version [37]
- **Loser** (1 review): Garcia's Loser solo is praised among a run of first-set solos at the end of the set [34]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer considers this the best-played Crazy Fingers of 1982 [32]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Bobby ad-libs and goes wild again in the Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance [35]
- Opening the second set with Playing in the Band signaled the band meant business [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-10-10.mtx.seamons.110744.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1982-10-10.sbd.tetzeli.ayers.79903.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1982-10-10.mtx.seamons.fix.92058.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 182 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Matrix re-synced portions of nearly all songs, raised soundboard levels in encores, and boosted audience levels during Drums and Space [8]
- **gd1982-10-10.167624.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 185 min [14]
- **gd82-10-10.sbd.sacks.338.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4.62/5 by 52 [27]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds fine but omits Space and Garcia's long introduction to The Wheel, a bigger gap than the tape flip [28]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- Audience recordings captured the friendly ambience of Frost; crowd sang along with Bobby on Satisfaction [38]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best first sets and their favorite first set of 1982 [31]
- Compared with later shows, the voices are in prime shape and Jerry's playing is excellent [33]
- Show is said to top people's lists of favorites, especially among 1982 shows, with a standout first set [34]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-10-10.mtx.seamons.110744.flac24**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF tracking via Audacity > FLAC24 via xACT) [1]
- **gd1982-10-10.sbd.tetzeli.ayers.79903.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: MC>DAT>ZA2>CD>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: Soundboard was patched using Rango Keshavan's audience source, shnid 29315, with crossfades and matched pitch and volume [5]
- **gd1982-10-10.mtx.seamons.fix.92058.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/AUD (About 60%/40%) [8]. Also: Audience source: Sony ECM-220T mics into Sony TC-D5, then DAT and CDR; matrixed by Hunter Seamons in Final Cut Pro [8]
- **gd1982-10-10.167624.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes (patched out of Bob Menke); Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII) [14]
- **gd82-10-10.sbd.sacks.338.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD:MCass>(?)DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [27]. Also: Reviewer once owned audience tapes of this show and considered them the best auds they had [38]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/frost-amphitheatre-1982-10-10) [41]

claims.song: It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
claims.text: Jerry delivers a heartfelt, well-sung Baby Blue as the second encore
Soundboard was patched using Rango Keshavan's audience source, shnid 29315, with crossfades and matched pitch and volume
Audience source: Sony ECM-220T mics into Sony TC-D5, then DAT and CDR; matrixed by Hunter Seamons in Final Cut Pro
Matrix re-synced portions of nearly all songs, raised soundboard levels in encores, and boosted audience levels during Drums and Space
Master cassettes came from Mark Severson; Charlie Miller made the transfer; Nakamichi 700 source from Bob Wagner supplies a short patch
This version includes the Wheel space within the track
